# Denver CO Painting

> Commercial, HOA and multifamily painting for the Denver metro by Painter Hotline's commercial crews. Offices, retail, restaurants, medical offices, HOA community repaints, apartment turns and tenant-improvement / new-construction painting. Phone 720-208-5645. Bids in person or from photos, customer's choice. Fully insured; 5-year written workmanship warranty; over 20 years of experience. Paints with all major brands (Sherwin-Williams, Benjamin Moore, Behr, Valspar, PPG).

- [Apartment Painting for Property Managers: Turns & Common Areas](https://denvercopainting.com/apartment-painting/): Apartment painting in the Denver metro: unit turns, hallways, stairwells and exteriors to your standard colors, with pre-1978 lead rules built into the schedule.
- [Tenant Improvement & New Construction Painting | Denver Metro](https://denvercopainting.com/new-construction-tenant-improvement-painting/): TI and new construction painting for Denver-metro builders and general contractors: bid to your finish schedule, primer on new drywall, punch-list close-out.
- [Medical & Dental Office Painting After Clinic Hours | Denver Metro](https://denvercopainting.com/medical-office-painting/): Medical and dental office painting in the Denver metro: after-hours shifts, one room at a time, low-odor products and washable finishes. Request a bid.
- [Request a Commercial Painting Bid | Denver CO Painting](https://denvercopainting.com/request-a-commercial-bid/): Request a commercial, HOA or apartment painting bid in the Denver metro. In-person walkthrough or photo bid, your choice. Reply within one business day.

## Guides
- [HOA Painting Bid Specification: How Boards Get Comparable Bids](https://denvercopainting.com/blog/hoa-painting-bid-specification/): How a Colorado HOA board writes one painting scope so every bid prices the same job: surfaces, prep, repairs, products, coats, colors, phasing, warranty.
- [Asbestos Inspection Before a Commercial Repaint in Colorado (160 sq ft Rule)](https://denvercopainting.com/blog/asbestos-inspection-before-commercial-repaint/): Colorado's CDPHE asbestos inspection triggers for commercial buildings (160 sq ft / 260 linear ft) and how they fit a tenant improvement painting schedule.
- [Apartment Make-Ready Paint Checklist for Property Managers](https://denvercopainting.com/blog/apartment-make-ready-paint-checklist/): A 10-step paint checklist for apartment make-readies: touch-up vs repaint, patching, stain-blocking, standard sheens, wet areas and pre-1978 lead timing.

## Facts used on this site (with sources)
- Colorado has about 11,800 community associations and about 2.568M residents in them (CAI 2025 Statistical Review). 8,362 active HOA registrations at end of 2024 (Colorado Division of Real Estate).
- CDPHE: inspection by a Colorado-certified asbestos inspector before disturbing >160 sq ft / 260 linear ft in public and commercial buildings; >32 sq ft / 50 linear ft in single-family homes.
- CDPHE Regulation 19: pre-renovation education for pre-1978 housing when 2+ sq ft of painted surface is disturbed; Renovate Right pamphlet at least 7 days before work.
- Sherwin-Williams Duration Exterior applies down to 35°F; Benjamin Moore Aura Exterior 35–100°F.
